messages:
Claire: Posted RCA for the 2026-05-10 artifact checksum incident: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2604|RCA: artifact checksum mismatch -> unintended model rollback>. TL;DR: a corrupted model artifact upload slipped past CI checksum validation, triggering our rollback automation which served an older quantized variant for ~11 minutes. Result: higher p95 latency and a small uptick in tokenization errors for ~0.8% of requests. No data exfiltration.

Claire: Owners & immediate asks below — please confirm ETAs and blockers.

OWNER ACTIONS:
- Harden artifact upload validation to include multipart checksum + size verification (Omar) — PR + canary by 2026-05-14.
- Add CI gate to reject uploads with mismatched artifact manifest hashes and add a verification job (Nadia) — job + alert by 2026-05-13.
- Add a lightweight pre-deploy smoke that validates model hash vs serving manifest and aborts rollback if mismatch suspected (Sam) — spec + PR by 2026-05-15.
- Exec summary for ops digest and customer comms draft (Claire) — draft by EOD.

Omar: Taking artifact validation. Will add multipart MD5 checks and a redundant streaming hash. Need a short maintenance window for rollout.

Nadia: Will add the CI gate and a dashboard showing failed manifest verifications. Plan to reuse the upload pipeline test harness.

Sam: Pre-deploy smoke sounds good. My concern: we need it sub-500ms to avoid deploy delays. I'll prototype a quick metadata-only verification.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-35701 created and RCA 2604 linked. Owners: Omar, Nadia, Sam, Claire.

Claire: Exec-summary draft: "On 2026-05-10 a bad model artifact upload bypassed a checksum edge-case, causing an automated rollback to an older quantized variant for ~11 minutes. This led to a transient increase in latency and minor tokenization errors for a small percentage of requests. We have implemented detection measures and owners are tracked to close fixes by 2026-05-15." Thoughts?

Omar: LGTM. Will note the maintenance window in my PR.

Nadia: +1. I'll attach CI job logs when ready.

Sam: OK — prototyping now. If we can't keep smoke under 500ms I'll propose a soft-fail that flags but doesn't block deploys until the canary run completes.

Claire: Uploaded suspect artifact and logs here: <https://internal.redwood.com/artifacts/incident-2604|artifact bundle>. Includes the failing checksum block and rollback timeline.

Omar: PR opened: <https://git.redwood.com/infra/patches/1122|fix/artifact-validation>. Adding tests and a canary plan.

Nadia: CI gate job merged to staging; linking job output in this thread once green.

Sam: Smoke check implemented in staging — 420ms median. Will include results from canary.

Claire: Weekly checkpoint scheduled 2026-05-16 09:00 PT. Please update INC-35701 with PR links, canary metrics, and deployment notes. I'll consolidate final closure notes here once all items are merged. :white_check_mark:

Omar: noted.

Nadia: will post dashboard link when promoted.

Sam: will attach smoke canary graphs after run.

Claire: Thanks all. Keep this thread as single source of truth for follow-ups. If blockers arise, escalate to oncall.
